claims.statement: If A is real symmetric, s3(A)>=1, and a=A_hh is a nonzero original-coordinate scalar pivot, then the exact Schur complement S=A[K,K]-a^{-1}A[K,h]A[h,K] satisfies s2(S)>=1 and e2(S^2)>=1.
claims.scope: deterministic matrix statement; no probabilistic rotation

claims.statement: Under the product-source hypotheses and s3(A)>=1, if some original coordinate has |A_hh|>=1/256, then either ||p_Q||_infinity<337.952, or an anchored O1 full-A third-minor packet has mass >1/9437184 with at most two heavy row and two heavy column anchors, or an O2/O3 full-A third-minor stratum containing h has mass at least 1/196608.
claims.continuity: not claimed on the new outer-square payment

claims.statement: If the disjoint residual Schur second-minor mass M0 is at least 1/3 and at least one side of the squared-minor volume law has all inclusion marginals <=2/3, then ||p_Q||_infinity<337.952.

If both row and column E2 volume marginals exceed 2/3 in the M0>=1/3 branch, there are physical anchors i,j whose residual anchored E2 mass exceeds 1/144 and whose lifted full-A third-minor packet, together with outer pivot h, exceeds 1/9437184.
No full universal density theorem or counterexample is claimed by this run.
